name: DAMIC-M
full_name: Dark Matter In CCDs at Modane
summary: DAMIC-M is a low-background Skipper-CCD dark-matter programme at Modane, increasing silicon mass and using repeated nondestructive readout to improve single-electron resolution.
detection_principle: Repeated measurements of each pixel's charge average down electronic noise, resolving few-charge signals in thick silicon. Clean materials and underground shielding reduce low-energy backgrounds.

sites.name: LSM
sites.location: Underground laboratory in the Fréjus tunnel, Modane
sites.site_status: Experiment site; see the phase descriptions

status.label: Multiple phases with different statuses
status.evidence: The Low Background Chamber prototype has produced results. A 2025 institutional annual report describes new results and preparation of the main detector; full-detector completion requires current confirmation.

key_parameters.name: Technology approach
key_parameters.value: Thick, fully depleted silicon CCDs with Skipper readout

results.summary: The prototype provided initial physics searches with low-noise silicon CCDs.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
